items.title: How do Americans feel about the midterm results? It depends on how much money they make.

items.title: Microsoft and Amazon combined to see a $424 billion market-cap boost — and these factors show why
items.content: Microsoft and Amazon shares rose sharply on Wednesday, with one portfolio manager noting that a cloud-supply crunch could help the companies raise prices.

items.title: Big Tech is driving a historic divide in the S&P 500. Why investors need to take notice.
items.content: A historic divergence has split the U.S. stock market: The benchmark S&P 500 index has tumbled into deeply oversold territory even as nearly half of its constituent stocks remained decidedly overbought.

items.title: ‘It’s good to be old’: I’ve been invited to a dozen free meals that turn into annuity sales pitches. Should I stop going?

items.title: Dow scores its best day in 18 months in a broad relief rally after Democrats sweep to power in Congress
items.content: Stocks surged, oil prices plunged and bond yields fell Wednesday on optimism around a quicker end to the Iran war now that Democrats have clinched control of Congress.
